risks.title: Dependence on Government Contracts
risks.score_rationale: The risk is central in the 10-K, mentioned at the outset of forward-looking statements. The language emphasizes critical dependence on government budgets and approvals. Weighting is maximal as operations rely almost entirely on public contracts, particularly federal ones. Ranked as the top risk.

risks.title: Loss of Credibility with the Government
risks.score_rationale: Listed first among forward-looking risk factors, with strong language: 'compromises our relationships' and 'damage our professional reputation'. The risk is existential as it threatens access to public markets. Reputation category is heavily weighted in the defense sector.

risks.title: Changes in Government Priorities
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly cited in forward-looking statements. The intensity of language ('shift expenditures away') and the unstable geopolitical context justify high severity. Less existential than contract loss, but structural.

risks.title: Cyberattacks or System Failures
risks.score_rationale: The risk is mentioned in forward-looking statements and has a dedicated disclosure item (Item 1C). The language is alarming ('security breaches', 'internal system failures'). As a defense contractor, cybersecurity is critical. Category is highly weighted.

risks.title: Difficulty Recruiting Personnel with Security Clearances
risks.score_rationale: Cited in forward-looking risks with strong language ('inability to attract, train or retain'). The need for security clearances is crucial for federal operations. Less existential than contract loss, but structural for growth.

risks.title: Competitor Protests on Contracts
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned in forward-looking risks with direct operational impact ('delays, contract terminations or cancellations'). The sector is highly competitive. Risk is heightened by the size of public contracts. Moderately weighted category.

risks.title: Non-Renewal of Key Contracts
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly cited as a major risk ('termination or nonrenewal of our government contracts'). Language is unambiguous and the risk is repeated across multiple sections. Directly tied to the sustainability of the business model.

ai_positioning.summary: The company PSN does not mention artificial intelligence (AI) or machine learning in its 10-K report. The information provided focuses on financial aspects, business segments, and company operations, with no reference to AI.
